_about: The addresses of this product's published site (base below) that are held OUTSIDE the site: the program, the READMEs, the Store listing source, the release workflow. SITE-STRUCTURE rule 8 (SP-0153). Read by packaging/check-external-docs.ps1, step 'addresses': every entry must resolve to a public page (or a forwarder stub) and its anchor must exist on it, every holder must still contain the address, and every address found in a surface but missing here fails. An address is permanent: when a page moves, leave a forwarder at the old path and keep the old entry until nothing holds it. The winget locale manifest holds the site root as its PackageUrl (SP-0166), so it is a holder here; the winget installer and version manifests hold github.com addresses only. Not listed on purpose: the sibling products' sites (owned by those products).
